title: "What the assistant was given" — the shortened-file line

steps.path: Project context tab, on a small model that could not fit the whole rules file
steps.headline: A shortened rules file now says "Shortened to fit this model" instead of "3 of 12 sections above are shown as…".
steps.changed: Your round 2 note on R2-6. The old line was a note written for the assistant, shown to you unchanged. The card now says one plain thing under the file name. The "What it got / What was cut" switch right below still shows exactly what was left out.
steps.notice: The amber dot and the switch are unchanged. A file that was not shortened still reads "Read before every chat in this project".
steps.risk: The line no longer says how much was shortened; you open "What was cut" to see.
